nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Regional gray matter volume (GMV) estimates from T1-weighted VBM; aggregated into 1,032 brain areas.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: We used an established pipeline to obtain voxel-wise estimates of GMV in each participant 25,26 (Methods), which we aggregated into regional estimates for 1,032 brain areas 27,28 (1,000 cortical and 32 subcortical regions; Fig. 2a).

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age, Sex, and Site were used as covariates in the HBR model.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: We then trained a normative model based on hierarchical Bayesian regression (HBR)... to establish a normative GMV range given an individual's age, sex and scan site
